title: osw-online-television
label: Chris Colton

won.source: The fed's own video-library index: "Chris Colton defeats Dark Soul in the finals of a four-man tourney to win the OSW Television Title," dated 04/02/02.

how: won a four-man tournament final over Dark Soul
note: Defended against Brian Anthony on 14 May 2002 and Jack Collins on 20 August 2002; still champion in the fed's own 4 December 2002 update, his only loss a non-title match.

label: Def Bellows

won.source: The fed's own Field Trip card: Def Bellows beats Kazuyuki Saga in the tournament final and is announced the new OSW Old-School Heavyweight Champion.

how: won the final of an eight-man tournament over Kazuyuki Saga
note: Retained against Kazuyuki Saga on 1 December 2002; still champion in the fed's own 4 December 2002 update.

title: osw-online-tagteam
label: Sexual Energy

won.source: The fed's own Field Trip card: Sexual Energy beat Reynolds & Bardon and are announced the new OSW Unified Tag Team Champions.
